categories.main_business_segments: China Merchants Securities operates primarily in five business segments: wealth management and institutional business, investment banking, investment management, investment and trading, and others including head office operations and investment holding. The wealth management and institutional business segment includes brokerage, margin financing, securities lending, and financial product sales. Investment banking covers equity and debt financing and financial advisory services. Investment management involves asset management and private equity fund management. Investment and trading includes equity, fixed-income, derivatives trading, and market making.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes digital intelligent transformation and technology-driven development, including AI-driven securities company initiatives. It leverages cloud-native digital infrastructure, AI applications in research and trading, and financial technology innovations such as intelligent investment advisory platforms and AI research institutes. The firm also employs advanced risk management IT systems integrating big data, machine learning, and stress testing for market, credit, and operational risks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CMS serves individual investors, institutional clients such as mutual funds, private funds, banks, insurance firms, and asset management companies, as well as corporate clients including listed companies. It provides comprehensive financial services across capital markets, wealth management, investment banking, and asset management. The company also targets high-net-worth clients and supports technological innovation enterprises and green finance projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Mainland China with extensive branch networks across provinces including Guangdong, Beijing, Shanghai, and others. It also has significant operations outside Mainland China, notably through its wholly-owned subsidiary CMS International in Hong Kong, serving clients in Japan, Singapore, and Europe. The company’s service network covers major capital markets globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Merchants Securities operates primarily as a midstream and downstream financial services provider in the securities industry. It acts as an intermediary in capital markets through brokerage, underwriting, asset management, and advisory services, facilitating capital flow between investors and issuers. It also engages in proprietary trading and market making, positioning itself as a comprehensive financial services firm.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include intensive operations, digital intelligent transformation, technology-driven development, and global expansion. It focuses on five key areas: technology finance, green finance, inclusive finance, pension finance, and digital finance. CMS is advancing AI integration across business lines, developing an AI-driven securities company, enhancing digital platforms, and investing in fintech innovation to support transformation and high-quality growth.
categories.revenue_model: CMS generates revenue through multiple streams including fee and commission income from brokerage, underwriting, asset management, and advisory services; interest income from margin financing, securities lending, and proprietary investments; and net gains from investment and trading activities. The company also earns income from custody and fund administrative services, and other financial products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CMS is one of the leading comprehensive securities firms in China, recognized as a benchmarking enterprise by SASAC. It holds top rankings in wealth management, custody services, and investment banking within the industry. Major competitors include CITIC Securities, GF Securities, China Galaxy Securities, and Ping An Securities. CMS leverages its strong China Merchants Group backing and extensive branch network to maintain a competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the end of 2024, CMS reported total assets of RMB721.16 billion and net capital of RMB87.41 billion. The company achieved total revenue of RMB30.62 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB10.39 billion, representing year-on-year increases of 2.00% and 18.51%, respectively. The company maintains a strong liquidity position and a gearing ratio of 77.13%, with steady growth in client assets and business scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CMS emphasizes its strong brand affiliation with China Merchants Group, comprehensive one-stop financial services, and a profound customer base supported by an extensive branch network. It differentiates itself through advanced financial technology capabilities, including AI-driven platforms and cloud-native infrastructure, and a robust risk management culture. The company focuses on serving national strategic priorities, supporting technological innovation, green finance, and delivering high-quality, efficient, and innovative financial products and services.
